primary_interest.quote: So my understanding is you're looking at SIP trunking as part of a contact center modernization.

use_case.quote: We're running a legacy contact center on old trunks, and we're moving to a cloud setup.

edge_framing.quote: you can buy that on its own through the API. It doesn't need to be tied to anything else we sell.

edge_raised_by.quote: Can I throw in something you didn't ask about? Edge compute.

competitors_edge.quote: Some on AWS Lambda, and we've poked at Cloudflare Workers for a couple of smaller things.

competitors_voice.quote: Mostly Twilio for the newer pieces. We also have some capacity with Bandwidth

decision_criteria.quote: Cost is the big thing for me. Per-minute, per-token, the total picture. I want to see it all in one place, not find surprises in month three.

stated_reason.quote: Our requirement is EU. Data has to stay in-region, and we'd need a DPA signed before anything goes live.
